patch.value: GH-954: fail-fast dependency target validation with explicit forward-reference intent
Reject unresolved dependency targets during create/update unless the caller explicitly opts into a forward reference; keep graph truth and repair semantics discoverable.

Create and update reject unresolved dependency ids by default; an explicit allow-unresolved contract records intentional forward references; help SDK contracts MCP and completions expose additive replacement removal and forward-reference semantics; structured recovery names search dep-remove replace-deps and clear-deps; tests cover create update bulk and transaction paths
Make dependency writes referentially truthful by default
Agents receive immediate recovery instead of silently corrupting the graph
GitHub #954 demonstrates that the accepted-forward-reference decision in pm-ol5v remains unsafe and combines with strict relationship policy
Unresolved dependency writes require explicit intent
Current create and update silently persist unresolved ids
